items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He wasn't like Willie the Lion, I mean he didn't -- [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, no, no. He didn't go into anything that made me, you know, uncomfortable.

ctx.x: I was always out of town.
Well, I mean, was he the same class as the Lion, Fats...
Well, yeah. He was the same school. The same school.
